episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Flailing at life, Lee Tang panics after he kills a man after work. Soon, Jang Nan`Gam is on the case — discovering a disturbing truth about the victim.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A mysterious woman approaches Tang, claiming to know his secret and begins to blackmail him. The weight of his actions starts taking a mental toll.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Nan Gam struggles to find clear answers as he investigates the latest deaths. After connecting with an enigmatic figure, Tang decides to turn himself in.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Wondering if the same killer is behind all the murders, Nan Gam probes Roh Bin for clues, leading to an unlikely partnership between the two.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Nan Gam notices a clear pattern among the recent murders, he searches for Tang — unaware of another mysterious man who is doing the same.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: In his search for Tang, Song Chon confronts Bin — who desperately turns to Nan Gam for help. But Tang agrees to meet with Chon, who has a proposition.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Nan Gam comes face to face with Chon, who recognizes him from the past. As Bin and Tang plan their final escape, Bin receives a menacing phone call.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The endgame to the chase leads to a final fight — and it's everyone versus Chon. In the process, Nan-gam finally learns the truth about his father.
